name: South Side
blurb: A city district sandbox of streets and alleys: the area around the author's spawn, cut from a larger map.
author: Fishke
attribution: Geometry converted from rp_southside, https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2010286798 by Fishke. The author's textures are not carried: surfaces use this game's materials over Kenney's Prototype Textures (CC0). The author can have this conversion removed: contact https://github.com/zees-games/playlot-maps/issues.
